comment: None of the eighteen jacks is named in configOutput, and the panel art carries no lettering; the names in the census are blank and the labels beside the jacks are drawn at runtime from the controller names OSC'elot passes across. Output indices are TRIG_OUTPUT 0 to 7, CV_OUTPUT 8 to 15, then the poly trigger jack at 16 and the poly CV jack at 17, which the widget places as the pair at the top. OscelotExpander.cpp process() returns out of the middle of its loop on the first controller whose value is below zero, so where an earlier slot is unmapped the jacks past it hold their last value instead of resting; it also allocates a new expander message every 64 samples without freeing the one before.
